question: Under leakage-controlled, project-disjoint evaluation, does graph learning beat co-change history for file-level change impact?
status: final before development training (2026-11-22); frozen by research_v2 freeze
test_selection_note: Chosen 2026-11-21 before any were cloned. None appear in SWE-bench Verified, BugsInPy or the v1 manifests.
query_sampling: one seed per eligible commit, chosen by the smallest sha256(commit + NUL + seed path); commits sampled uniformly without replacement by random.Random(sha256(seed:repo:stream)); streams train, validation, test
sample_size_basis: v1 paired SD 0.299: 281 paired queries detect a 0.05 macro Recall@5 difference at alpha 0.05, power 0.8; 500 test queries detect about 0.037
use_semantics_decision: Cost rule: keep CodeBERT only if it is at most 40% of preparation time. The pilot (artifacts/reports/v2-pilot.json, 20 queries per development project) measured 85-96% in every project, so it is excluded.

model_search.rule: each GNN arm keeps the variant with the highest selection macro recall_at_5 (ties: ndcg_at_10, smaller hidden size, then losses order)
model_search.note: bce is v1's weighted pointwise loss; bpr is a pairwise Bayesian Personalized Ranking loss over sampled positive/negative pairs

learned_system_notes.xgboost: binary classifier on the seven pair features
learned_system_notes.xgboost-ltr: LambdaMART ranker (objective rank:ndcg) on the same features, one group per query

hybrid.form: weighted reciprocal-rank fusion of cochange-v1 with one GNN
hybrid.tie_break: smaller GNN weight, then gnn_choices order

selection_rule: primary = learned system with the highest selection macro recall_at_5 (ties: ndcg_at_10, then name); baseline = non-learned system chosen the same way; both on validation selection queries only
statistics: paired per-query differences; repository-macro mean; 95% bootstrap CI with projects fixed and with projects resampled; two-sided paired sign-flip test (10,000 draws, seed 17); Holm correction across all comparisons with the primary; pooled Wilcoxon as a secondary check
success_gate: primary minus baseline macro recall_at_5 is positive with two-sided sign-flip p < 0.05
secondary_analyses: primary vs baseline by candidate-pool size: <=500, 501-2000, >2000 files
primary vs baseline by number of changed files: 1, 2-3, 4+
never: clone or ingest a test repository before the v2 freeze
re-run the v2 evaluation after results exist
